description: Delete your existing inbox and revoke access to its mailbox content. Useful after testing is complete; it does not read messages or extract codes. Takes inbox_id, capability and access_token from create_email_inbox. No additional charge or new payment. Deletion is destructive: read needed messages before deleting.

access_token.description: Use the scoped access_token returned by create_email_inbox. Optional only for an existing provisioned private pilot connection.
